No ads. No tracking. No third-party SDKs. One purchase, every device.

Built in pure SwiftUI from the ground up. Not a web wrapper, not a port. Designed for each form factor:

Easy through Evil are not guesses. Every puzzle is solved by an engine that
uses real human techniques - naked and hidden singles, locked candidates,
pairs and triples, X-Wing, XY-Wing, Swordfish - and graded by what it actually

Evil. Build a streak, collect medals on the calendar, and compare your time

Stuck? A hint explains the deduction - "R4C7 is the only cell in box 6 that can

learned the pattern.

Bronze to Grandmaster. Your rating reflects recent form rather than hours
logged, so the badge says how you are playing now. Points bank permanently,
medals are awarded against a per-difficulty par time, and 18 achievements track
the milestones.

TEN ENEMIES AND A WARLORD

newReleases.name: Run Dummy
newReleases.desc:
Run Dummy is a 3D maze runner starring a crash-test dummy on the loose in a neon laboratory. Steer with simple tank controls, memorize the corridors, and reach the reward well before the clock runs out.

THE LAB IS BOOBY-TRAPPED
Every trial hides hazards between you and the exit: spinning blades, floor spikes, dart launchers, crumbling tiles, moving walls, one-way doors, teleporters, and pressure switches that open gates across the maze. The walls can't hurt you — the traps will.

RUN. REMEMBER. ESCAPE.
- 35 trials across 5 chapters, from gentle warm-up lattices to the deep lab
- A chase camera with a rear-view mirror, so nothing sneaks up behind you
- Tactile haptics, footstep audio, and a moody synth soundtrack
- Up to 3 stars per trial: finish the run, beat the target time, stay nearly untouched
- Chase camera tuned for long corridors and split-second turns

UNLOCK THE CREW
Chain wall streaks — clean runs without kissing the walls — to unlock new runners, each with its own look: Dummy, Bolt, Bulwark, Wraith, and Gilded. Star collectors can earn fresh ball-skin finishes too.

FREE POWER-UPS

Only the traps can stop you. How far can you run?

Direct port of the original title

좋아하는 K-pop 곡을 실제 주식처럼 사고파는 시뮬레이션 게임, 사운드스톡이에요.
곡의 실시간 인기에 따라 시세가 실제로 오르내리기 때문에, 내가 좋아하는 곡의 인기를 응원하는 재미와 투자의 재미를 동시에 느낄 수 있어요.

[실시간 시세로 움직이는 곡 주식]
곡마다 인기도에 따라 가격이 실시간으로 변동해요. 저평가된 곡을 미리 발견해서 낮은 가격에 사두면, 그 곡이 뜨는 순간 수익으로 돌아와요.

[아직 뜨지 않은 명곡, 내가 먼저 상장]
차트에 없는 숨은 명곡도 직접 상장할 수 있어요. 남들보다 먼저 발견해서 상장하면, 그 곡의 창업자 지분을 갖고 시세 상승의 주인공이 될 수 있어요.

[금, 부동산 다양한 투자]
주식 말고도 금 시세에 투자하거나, 부동산을 매입해 월세를 받을 수 있어요.

[함께 투자하는 재미]
친구를 추가해서 자산을 비교하고, 채팅방에서 종목을 추천하거나 함께 모금함을 만들어 투자할 수 있어요. 주간라이브를 확인해 전략적으로 게임을 플레이 해보세요!

[랭킹과 배지로 실력을 증명]
전체 유저 중 내 자산 순위와 등급(개미부터 세력까지)을 확인하고, 다양한 도전 배지를 모아보세요.

지금 사운드스톡에서, 내가 좋아하는 노래로 투자를 시작해보세요.

- no adverts, no in-app purchases, no account, and no internet connection

Easy through Evil are not guesses. Every puzzle is solved by an engine that
uses real human techniques - naked and hidden singles, locked candidates,
pairs and triples, X-Wing, XY-Wing, Swordfish - and graded by what it actually

learned the pattern.

Bronze to Grandmaster. Your rating reflects recent form rather than hours

medals are awarded against a per-difficulty par time, and 18 achievements track

A HERO YOU COMMAND

TEN ENEMIES AND A WARLORD
Goblins, grunts, bat swarms, armored brutes, healing shamans, warg riders, sappers, berserkers, cave trolls, wyverns — and Gorrak himself on the final wave. Armor, magic resistance, flight, healing an

Run Dummy is a 3D maze runner starring a crash-test dummy on the loose in a neon laboratory. Steer with simple tank controls, memorize the corridors, and reach the reward well before the clock runs out.

THE LAB IS BOOBY-TRAPPED
Every trial hides hazards between you and the exit: spinning blades, floor spikes, dart launchers, crumbling tiles, moving walls, one-way doors, teleporters, and pressure switches that open gates across the maze. The walls can't hurt you — the traps will.

RUN. REMEMBER. ESCAPE.
- 35 trials across 5 chapters, from gentle warm-up lattices to the deep lab
- A chase camera with a rear-view mirror, so nothing sneaks up behind you
- Tactile haptics, footstep audio, and a moody synth soundtrack
- Up to 3 stars per trial: finish the run, beat the target time, stay nearly untouched
- Chase camera tuned for long corridors and split-second turns

UNLOCK THE CREW
Chain wall streaks — clean runs without kissing the walls — to unlock new runners, each with its own look: Dummy, Bolt, Bulwark, Wraith, and Gilded. Star collectors can earn fresh ball-skin finishes too.

FREE POWER-UPS
Grab power-ups from the Power-Ups screen before a big attempt: Speed Boost, Shield, Long Jump, Time Freeze, and Extra Hearts. Every power-up is included free — equip as many as you like. There are no purchases, no subscriptions, and no ads anywhere in the game.

Only the traps can stop you. How far can you run?

The dark vast world of Castlevania that canonized the iconic whip-wielding character moves of Simon Belmont and the classic music tracks.

Relax, split wood, and watch it stack. Free to play, and no ads - just oddly satisfying splits and sounds recorded from the real thing.

I love splitting firewood so much that I 3D scanned my actual stump and axe and wood and recorded my axe motions and splitting sounds and made this 3D firewood splitting simulator so that you could experience exactly what I love about splitting firewood.

Tap to split, and drag to rotate the camera. Satisfying splits every time, automatic wood stacking, and ASMR sounds - this is a simple relaxing game that aims to capture what makes splitting wood outside so peaceful. 

There are no ads and the game is completely free if you want to split wood purely for the joy of it.

► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

all.name: Colorever: Gem Art Puzzle
all.desc:
"Colorever: relax with sparkling gems and beautiful coloring art.

Every gem belongs somewhere. Tap a gem and watch the whole cluster glide home, one by one, until a bright gem art picture is complete. Easy for everyone, fun for all ages. No timers. No fail screens. No game over. Just you, the gems, and a calm little puzzle you can always solve.

WHY PLAYERS STAY

See the whole picture from the start. Nothing is hidden, nothing is guesswork. You always know where every gem is going, so the pleasure comes from planning the route, not from hunting for a secret. Colorever is a puzzle funny game you can play with your shoulders down.

HOW TO PLAY

Tap a gem, move a cluster. Tap one gem and every connected gem of the same color is picked up together, then flies to its matching space one gem at a time.
Read the board. Each space on the board already shows the color of the gem it is waiting for. Match gem to space and it locks into place with a satisfying click.
Use the tray. The tray holds gems you are not ready to place yet. Park a few, open up the board, then bring them back in when the space is free.
Finish the picture. Place the last gem and the full gem art scene lights up, ready for your gallery.

A GROWING GEM GALLERY

Hundreds of pixel art pictures to complete, from animals and food to flowers, cities and cozy little scenes, with fresh sets added regularly. Every picture you finish is saved to your gallery, so your collection of gems and gem art keeps growing as you play.

all.name: Jelly Busters: Puzzle Game
all.desc:
Drop into the smoothest skatepark in town with the Jelly Busters crew, a squad of bouncy jellies who live to skate, color shoot, and bust their way through walls of cubes. Every run starts with a simple push on your board, a quick aim, and a clean shot as you send your jelly flying into a glowing, colorful puzzle blast of cubes hiding a secret picture and image below.

Jelly Busters adds a fun, skate-infused twist packed with ASMR pleasure and arcade-style thrills. With every tap, you shoot into stacks of colors, bust the cubes, and slowly keep busting the image underneath until the whole board is clear.

The sound and feel are tuned for maximum satisfying chill. Cubes crumble with soft pops, jellies bounce just right, and the whole game wraps you in a relaxing mood that still demands fast reaction and strategic thinking. It’s the perfect combination: a cube shooter that’s as soothing as it is intense, always very satisfying to clear the image at the end of a run.

But the park has tricks of its own. From the very first levels, you’ll see that this isn’t just mindless tapping. The game develops and gets more challenging and harder as you play, with clever layouts and sneaky blockers that force you to plan ahead. Each new level adds a fresh twist - more cubes, tougher patterns, and smarter obstacles that you’ll have to avoid if you want to keep your blast streak going.

To keep things interesting, you’ll unlock powerful level boosters that turn tight spots into epic comebacks.
